implementation_notes: Require the upstream gem and use its models directly. Rails makes this easy to hide, so keep the require in one file so the conformity surface is visible.
idiom_name: one require file is the conformity surface
code_sketch:
# app/billing/upstream.rb — the ONLY file requiring the vendor gem
require "vendor/customers"
Customer = Vendor::Customers::Customer
pitfalls: The vendor model becoming an ActiveRecord model in the downstream, so the vendor schema drives the downstream DB
Monkey-patching the vendor class to add downstream behaviour
